title: Glomerular Filtration Rate Determination with Minipump Inulin Clearance
author: Jeff Hodgin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x63frgn

steps.title: Prepare Minipumps
steps.instruction: Fill micro-osmotic pumps with approximately 100 μl of a 3% FITC inulin solution.

steps.title: Surgically Implant Minipumps
steps.instruction: Insert two minipumps into the peritoneal cavity of the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize mice with isoflurane using a gas anesthetic machine.
Create an abdominal midline incision approximately 5 mm in length to insert the pumps.

steps.title: Collect Urine and Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 24-hour urine and a blood sample from the mouse after the recovery period.

substeps.instruction: Place mice in metabolic cages to collect 24-hour urine.
Immediately after urine collection, restrain the mouse inside a 50-mL centrifuge tube with air-holes drilled in the tip.
Shave the inner thigh and wipe with 70% ethanol to reveal the saphenous vein.
Make a small incision with a scalpel and collect 100-μl of blood using a heparinized capillary tube (Fisher Scientific).
Centrifuge the blood sample at 4000 rpm for 10 min and extract the plasma.

steps.title: Process Samples for Measurement
steps.instruction: Dilute urine and plasma samples and load them onto a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute urine samples 1:5 and 1:10 in HEPES.
Mix plasma samples with HEPES (pH 7.4) at a ratio of 4:1.
Load 50 μl of processed samples per well into a 96-well plate (COSTAR 3595).

steps.title: Measure Inulin Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure the fluorescence of the samples using a Fluoroscan Ascent FL (Labsystems).

substeps.instruction: Set excitation to 485 nm and emission to 530 nm.

steps.title: Generate Standard Curves
steps.instruction: Create standard curves for urine and plasma to determine FITC-inulin concentrations.

substeps.instruction: For the urine curve: Dilute 200 μl of normal mouse urine into 300 μl HEPES, then add 500 μl of FITC-inulin solution (dissolved in HEPES) of known concentrations. Use five points ranging from 0.05 mg/ml to 0.0008 mg/ml.
For the plasma curve: Mix 160 μl of normal mouse plasma with 40 μl of an inulin solution (made in HEPES) of known concentration. Use four points ranging from 0.005 mg/ml to 0.0006 mg/ml.

steps.title: Calculate GFR
steps.instruction: Calculate the Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) and express the result in ml/min/g body weight.

substeps.instruction: Divide the concentration of inulin excreted in urine by the concentration of plasma inulin.
